hlni.insight: Energy mapping: tracking which specific academic tasks (analytical vs. communicative) sustain your focus.
hlni.audienceGap: Students often choose degrees based on perceived prestige rather than daily task alignment.
hlni.viewerChange: The viewer moves from external validation to internal self-assessment of their own work style.
hlni.support: Task-based preference is a reliable indicator of sustained academic engagement and long-term interest.
hlni.payoff: Demonstrates that choosing based on personal energy leads to a more confident and informed academic decision.

reelTitle: B.Com vs BBA: The Energy Audit
objective: Help students choose based on personal task preference rather than external pressure.
targetAudience: +2 students seeking accessible, supportive guidance, including students worried about marks, confidence, or belonging

shots.name: The Dilemma
shots.visual: A student sits at a desk, looking stressed with two brochures labelled 'B.Com' and 'BBA' in front of them.
shots.dialogue: Stuck between B.Com and BBA? Stop staring at the titles.
shots.cameraPerformance: Close-up, slightly handheld for a relatable feel.

shots.name: The Audit Method
shots.visual: Split screen: Left side, the student is focused while calculating data. Right side, they are animated while presenting a group project.
shots.dialogue: Try an energy audit. Do you thrive digging into data, or does leading a debate fuel you?

shots.name: The Payoff
shots.visual: The student smiles, putting one brochure aside and keeping the other. They look confident.
shots.dialogue: Pick the path where your energy stays high. Trust your own focus, not the noise.
shots.cameraPerformance: Medium shot, soft lighting, warm tone.

productionNotes.editing: Fluid transitions between the audit comparison.
productionNotes.casting: A relatable student, mid-teens to early twenties.

creativeSummary.keyCreativeIdea: Shifting the B.Com vs BBA choice from label-focused comparison to an energy-based task audit.

selected.title: The 'Energy Audit' Method
selected.audienceGap: Students feel overwhelmed by the decision and look for external validation.
selected.hlni: Energy mapping: Tracking which tasks (calculating vs. presenting) drain or fuel your focus.
selected.viewerChange: Moves decision-making from 'what sounds impressive' to 'what sustains my focus'.
selected.concept: A student reflecting on two different tasks they did in school.
selected.device: A 'thought bubble' comparison of the student doing a spreadsheet vs. leading a debate.
selected.support: Self-awareness of task preference is a reliable indicator of long-term academic engagement.
methodSteps: Pick two tasks: one analytical, one communicative.
Rate your energy level before and after each.
Identify which state feels more 'natural' to sustain.
selected.interpretationRule: Choose the degree where the majority of weekly tasks align with your high-energy state.
selected.visibleProof: The student feels visibly drained by one task and energized by the other.
selected.payoff: The student feels empowered to trust their own preferences over peer pressure.
